subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Vocabulary e.g. stripes, spots, leopard, zebra, fur, claw, elephant, tail, cow, chicken, farmer, sheep, goat, tractor

show.line: Let's visit the animals! A zebra has stripes. A leopard has spots.

rounds.prompt: What animal is this? Say it.
Which animal lives on a farm?
rounds.praise: Yes! A cow lives on a farm.

rounds.prompt: Is it a farm animal or a wild animal? Sort the pictures.

hints: Look closely. Lines are stripes. Dots are spots.
Farm animals live with the farmer.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will name this animal.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It is a leopard. It has spots, not stripes.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Spots! It is a leopard.

parent_line: Can name animals in English and say if they live on a farm or in the wild.
